newsitem.title: CANADA: BHP unit terminates Sutton venture.
newsitem.headline: BHP unit terminates Sutton venture.

text.p: Sutton Resources Ltd said on Tuesday it received notice from BHP Minerals International Exploration Inc, a unit of Broken Hill Proprietary Co Ltd, terminating a joint venture on the northern portion of Sutton's Kagera nickel-cobalt-copper reconnaissance area in Tanzania.
Sutton said as a result of the deal's cancellation, Sutton has been restored to a 100-percent unencumbered interest in the entire Kagera reconnaissance licence.
It said the licence will remain in good standing until November 1997, and will be subject to discretionary yearly renewals thereafter.
Sutton said it is actively negotiating with other parties towards a new joint venture arrangement for both the Kagera reconnaissance area and the Kabanga nickel-cobalt-copper deposit.
